panels.title: DAG task outcomes (all DAGs, cumulative)
panels.description: Airflow's StatsD emitter bakes dag_id/task_id into the metric name itself (airflow_ti_finish_<dag>_<task>_<state>) rather than exposing them as labels, so this aggregates via a __name__ regex match - a plain sum()/count() over that pattern works fine, but increase()/rate() over it errors ('vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset', since those functions strip __name__ and the remaining labels collide) - see Pipeline Overview's per-DAG panel for the safe per-DAG-name workaround if a trend is needed.

panels.title: Flink-triggering DAG: task outcomes
panels.description: trigger_flink_job's 3 tasks (extract/submit_flink_job/notify), named explicitly since the generic __name__ regex above can't safely feed increase()/rate(). Links out to the Flink dashboard for drill-down on the seam between Airflow and Flink.

targets.expr: sum(increase(airflow_ti_finish_trigger_flink_job_extract_success[1h]) or vector(0)) + sum(increase(airflow_ti_finish_trigger_flink_job_submit_flink_job_success[1h]) or vector(0)) + sum(increase(airflow_ti_finish_trigger_flink_job_notify_success[1h]) or vector(0))

panels.title: Task duration (avg, by DAG)
panels.description: airflow_task_duration is a StatsD timer -> Prometheus Summary (sum+count, no histogram buckets), so this is an average, not a percentile. Uses a 1h rate window rather than the usual 10m - these sample DAGs are triggered manually (see the KubernetesExecutor up_for_reschedule limitation in CLAUDE.md), not continuously, so a narrow window reads 0/0=NaN (blank) between manual runs.

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeat rate / executor slot utilization
panels.description: Airflow's StatsD path exposes airflow_scheduler_heartbeat as a running counter, not a timestamp gauge - a healthy scheduler reads ~60/min via rate(), a stalled one drops to 0 (see the Control Tower L1 dashboard's identical pattern).

panels.title: Scheduler/worker logs (ERROR/WARN)
panels.description: Log message text (extracted from fluentbit's JSON envelope, not the raw JSON line) containing 'error' or 'warn' (case-insensitive), from every pod in the airflow namespace - not filtered to a specific DAG, see Pipeline Detail's per-pipeline Logs panel for that.
